params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: type
params.description:
Restrict results to a single document type.

* `page` - Knowledge Page
* `scribe` - Scribe Document

params.name: updated__gte
params.description: Last meaningful user edit at or after (ISO-8601). Targets a separate column from the response `updated_at` field, which is bumped on every save.

params.name: updated__lte
params.description: Last meaningful user edit at or before (ISO-8601). Targets a separate column from the response `updated_at` field, which is bumped on every save.

items.docs: Paginated list of every document accessible to your API key, ordered by creation date (newest first). Supports filtering by type, team, and creation/update date ranges. The default page size is 100 and the maximum is 100; use the `limit` and `offset` query parameters to paginate.
Fetch a single document by its UUID. The response includes per-action screenshot URLs for Scribe Documents and structured `content` for Knowledge Pages.
